decisions.reason: The firm has sunk development into this plural-component injection unit and publicly committed to it as part of its announced direction, so any weak results from 2020-2021 would be attributed to temporary pandemic-related construction slowdowns rather than prompting withdrawal.

As a second injection unit it is somewhat more exposed to rationalization, but management would justify keeping it as part of a tailored range for diverse specifications and blame any disappointment on temporary market conditions.
Automatic airless guns are core to the spray application business, and the invested tooling and visible commitment make continuation highly likely.
A manual airless gun is a staple complement to the firm's pumps with ongoing spare-part and service obligations, so management would persist with it.
The multi-model air-assisted airless line represents the largest investment and the most visible commitment to core spray technology, strongly favoring persistence.
The data logger embodies the firm's publicly announced move toward innovative, digital application technology, so management would defend it as strategic despite possibly modest uptake.
